Methods

This module implements the electronic structure methods available in SELQIE, including FCI, CISD, and selected CI calculations.

sci

Source: methods.f90:L11-L126

sci(n_orb, n_up, n_down, n_words, n_spin_orbs, n_basis, h, g, sel_method, conv, epsilon, cmin, energy, success, basis, c_out)

Performs a selected configuration interaction calculation.

Starting from the Hartree-Fock reference determinant, the selected determinant space is iteratively expanded, diagonalised, and pruned until the energy change between successive iterations falls below the convergence threshold.

Parameters

n_orb : integer

Number of spatial orbitals.

n_up : integer

Number of alpha electrons.

n_down : integer

Number of beta electrons.

n_words : integer

Number of words used to store each determinant.

n_spin_orbs : integer

Number of spin orbitals.

h : real(kind=dp), dimension(:,:)

One-electron integrals.

g : real(kind=dp), dimension(:,:,:,:)

Two-electron integrals.

sel_method : character(len=*)

Selection method used to generate new determinants.

conv : real(kind=dp)

Energy convergence threshold.

epsilon : real(kind=dp)

Selection threshold parameter.

cmin : real(kind=dp)

Minimum CI coefficient magnitude retained during pruning.

Returns

energy : real(kind=dp)

Converged SCI energy.

success : logical

Indicates whether the calculation completed successfully.

n_basis : integer

Number of determinants in the final selected space.

basis : integer(kind=8), allocatable, dimension(:,:)

Determinant basis of the final selected space.

c_out : real(kind=dp), allocatable, dimension(:)

CI coefficients corresponding to the final determinant basis.

prune

Source: methods.f90:L132-L156

prune(selected_space, n_sel_space, n_words, c, cmin)

Removes determinants whose CI coefficient magnitude falls below a specified threshold.

Parameters

selected_space : integer(kind=8), allocatable, dimension(:,:)

Determinant basis to be pruned.

n_sel_space : integer

Number of determinants currently in the selected space.

n_words : integer

Number of words used to store each determinant.

c : real(kind=dp), dimension(:)

CI coefficient vector.

cmin : real(kind=dp)

Minimum coefficient magnitude for a determinant to be retained.

Returns

selected_space : integer(kind=8), allocatable, dimension(:,:)

Pruned determinant basis.

n_sel_space : integer

Updated number of determinants after pruning.

cisd

Source: methods.f90:L161-L214

cisd(n_orb, n_up, n_down, n_words, n_spin_orbs, h_int, g_int, e_low, n_basis, success)

Performs a configuration interaction singles and doubles (CISD) calculation.

A determinant basis consisting of the reference determinant and all single and double excitations is generated and diagonalised using the Davidson solver.

Parameters

n_orb : integer

Number of spatial orbitals.

n_up : integer

Number of alpha electrons.

n_down : integer

Number of beta electrons.

n_words : integer

Number of words used to store each determinant.

n_spin_orbs : integer

Number of spin orbitals.

h_int : real(kind=dp), dimension(:,:)

One-electron integrals.

g_int : real(kind=dp), dimension(:,:,:,:)

Two-electron integrals.

Returns

e_low : real(kind=dp)

Lowest-energy eigenvalue.

n_basis : integer

Number of determinants in the CISD basis.

success : logical

Indicates whether the calculation completed successfully.

fci

Source: methods.f90:L216-L275

fci(n_orb, n_up, n_down, n_words, n_spin_orbs, h_int, g_int, e_low, n_basis, success)

Performs a full configuration interaction calculation.

All possible determinants compatible with the specified numbers of alpha and beta electrons are generated and diagonalised using the Davidson solver.

Parameters

n_orb : integer

Number of spatial orbitals.

n_up : integer

Number of alpha electrons.

n_down : integer

Number of beta electrons.

n_words : integer

Number of words used to store each determinant.

n_spin_orbs : integer

Number of spin orbitals.

h_int : real(kind=dp), dimension(:,:)

One-electron integrals.

g_int : real(kind=dp), dimension(:,:,:,:)

Two-electron integrals.

Returns

e_low : real(kind=dp)

Lowest-energy eigenvalue.

n_basis : integer

Number of determinants in the FCI basis.

success : logical

Indicates whether the calculation completed successfully.

combinations

Source: methods.f90:L277-L306

combinations(n, k, combos, n_combos)

Generates all unique combinations of k elements chosen from n elements.

This routine is used during FCI basis generation to enumerate all possible alpha and beta occupation strings.

Parameters

n : integer

Total number of available orbitals.

k : integer

Number of orbitals to occupy.

Returns

combos : integer, allocatable, dimension(k,n_combos)

Array containing all possible combinations.

n_combos : integer

Total number of combinations generated.
